question: Where is the abnormal impulse generated, if in the electrocardiogram we observe an inverted P wave, but the QRS complex and the T wave are normal ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Sinoauricular node -> abnormal impulse generation -> inverted P wave on ECG -> 95% CHAIN: Atrioventricular node -> normal impulse conduction -> normal QRS complex and T wave on ECG -> 90% CHAIN: Make of His -> normal impulse conduction -> normal QRS complex and T wave on ECG -> 85% CHAIN: Purkinje system -> normal impulse conduction -> normal QRS complex and T wave on ECG -> 95%
